title: Recruitment offer
summary: An unexpected job or task offer asks for money, documents, or access.
scenario: The offer promises quick income while avoiding normal employer checks.
warning_signs: Payment is required to start or unlock work
Requests for identity documents through an unverified channel
safe_actions: Do not pay to obtain work
Research the organization separately and use known contact details
Limit documents to what a verified process genuinely requires
recovery_guidance: Secure accounts and payment methods shared with the recruiter
Keep the offer, receipts, and conversation
reporting_guidance: Record the organization name and contact trail
Use an independently checked reporting destination
prevention_tips: Verify the employer before sharing sensitive information
Be cautious of guaranteed income claims
false_positive_notes: Legitimate employers can request information later, but the organization and process should be independently verifiable.
